---
name: Feature Request
about: Propose a new feature or enhancement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: CodesbyFebin
---

## Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve?
- Current limitation or issue
- Impact on users or developers
- Why it matters

## Proposed Solution
How should this feature work?
- Overview of the solution
- Key components or changes
- User experience

## Alternatives Considered
Have you considered alternative approaches?
- Option 1
- Option 2
- Why the proposed solution is better

## Use Cases
Real-world use cases or scenarios:
1. Use case 1
2. Use case 2

## Implementation Considerations
- Estimated complexity (small, medium, large)
- Dependencies or blockers
- Backward compatibility concerns
- Performance implications

## Additional Context
- Related issues or PRs
- References to similar features in other projects
- Any mockups or design sketches

---

Thank you for the feature request! We'll review it and discuss with the community.
